author: pi-glm

patch.value: Fail-closed privacy gate for automated GitHub issue imports and one reusable sync workflow

Automated fleet-wide sync is disabled because the pilot workflow pushes imported issue text to a public branch before any privacy gate inspects the proposed tracker diff. Add a fail-closed scanner over the proposed tracker change, wire it into import as --gate, and ship one reusable workflow_call sync workflow fleet repos can call.

A fresh checkout installs the pinned extension and exercises a nonempty issue import; malicious issue-body credential and personal-data fixtures prevent any public branch push; completeness and idempotency are checked before mutation; a clean import opens a reviewable PR with permanent PM links; existing pilot workflows and future rollouts use one audited implementation or equivalent gate.

value.author: pi-glm
value.text: Design settled: new gate.ts holds the pure scanner (credential/personal-data/host-path rules over ADDED lines only, sha256 content-hash allowlist with required written justification, fail-closed on unreadable input/git failure/malformed allowlist); unified-diff parser with toon field attribution + jsonl patch-entry attribution; git collector covers staged+working+untracked under the resolved tracker path and excludes operational locks/extensions/checkpoints subpaths. Registered as 'pm github gate' (--diff, --allowlist) and composed into import via --gate: plan completeness + provenance idempotency verified pre-mutation, tracker-change scan post-write, non-zero exit so a workflow can never push on a finding. Reusable workflow_call sync workflow added with SHA-pinned actions; caller example at docs/sync-workflow-caller.yml.
